existingPureGuards.scope: Five archive member guards and five both-path-container/actual body/path/Plan equality guards; not native or process functional certification

limitations: Ten guards cover their stated pure validators only; this reviewer did not rerun them.
Source/installed-JAR metadata and strict process closure are not native UDP, event-prefix business, scheduler, latency, throughput, hard real-time or capacity proof.
Output caps are post-execution checks of this frozen bounded helper, not a general live arbitrary-program output quota.

resourceQualification.consequence: Metadata PASS does not qualify a subsequent campaign. Its actual current reserve guard must reject until sufficient space is independently available. No cleanup was executed or authorized by this review.

reviewMethod: Manual source/diff review plus independently implemented local byte/data readback; no reviewed module imported or executed
sourceFindings: Fresh event-fetch metadata namespace and exact host/Linux/x86_64/root/JDK pins are checked before the first remote write. Existing namespace or benchmark PREP causes rejection; no resume or overwrite path.

Exactly four installed JARs plus the reviewed helper source and precompiled class form the six-file exclusive bundle. Each regular member is checked for allowlist, duplicate/canonical path, mode, size and SHA; links, directories and traversal are rejected. Upload has a 16MiB bound and no recursive extraction.

Local source/compiled helper, local closed manifest, actual local observation and independent local root review are cross-bound. Seven actual class origins and four complete distribution-JAR bodies are preserved; unloaded agrona body is not silently omitted.

Both actualCodeSources and distributionJars path containers relocate exclusively into the new remote lib directory; every other schema/selection/configuration/Plan value is exactly equal to the reviewed local observation. Plans16/32 differ in exactly eventFetchCount, selectedMaximumEventFetchRpcs and selectedMaximumLogicalMaintenanceRpcs.

Explicit prepare and execute modes are separate. Execute pins reviewed config/stager/remote source, exclusively records intent before its single subprocess.run SSH attempt, preserves timeout output and has no automatic retry.

Metadata-only command invokes EventFetchDistributionObservation. Referenced application classes are loaded for origins and pure Plan/codec derivation; no driver/client/owner constructor, cluster/main runner, socket, database, business RPC or cloud resource entrypoint is invoked. Temporary in-memory reference calculation is explicitly labelled.

Remote child identity captures PID/start ticks/full NUL argv SHA/actual executable, requires matching full argv, waits for normal exit and rejects identity gaps, timeout, changed inputs or non-absent PID. Only a fully matched owned child can receive timeout SIGTERM; no force kill or broad signal exists.

All writes target the new metadata namespace and its result files. No original application, PostgreSQL or historical benchmark payload is a write target. This source boundary review does not independently rehash the entire protected57 inventory.
